name: daily-cockpit
description: An Obsidian cockpit for reviewing yesterday's local agent work, resuming verified sessions, and decomposing tomorrow's intent into tasks.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node scripts/build-e2e.mjs && playwright test
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && node scripts/privacy-check.mjs && node scripts/readme-check.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:e2e
